open_points.subject: Customer revision after erasure
open_points.text:
An erasure does not move it: it removes the revision and the
  last-changed instant with every other fact but the identity, and records
  the erased mark with its own instant (M04, A04 rule 1; owner, 2026-11-24).
open_points.question: Is erasure an exception that replaces the Customer with an identity-preserving tombstone having no revision or last-changed instant, or must the accepted change first advance and retain the revision and last-changed instant as the unit's unconditional revision rule requires?
options: The erased Customer retains an advanced revision and last-changed instant
The erased Customer retains its previous revision and last-changed instant
The erased Customer is a tombstone with neither revision nor last-changed instant
open_points.default_guess: Treat erasure as an explicit exception and retain neither revision nor last-changed instant.

witness.initial: A live Customer has revision 3 and a last-changed instant.
events: The owner erases the Customer's contact data.
outcomes: Because every accepted change of a Customer's own facts moves its revision and paired last-changed instant, the result carries revision 4 and a new last-changed instant.
Because erasure removes the revision and last-changed instant, the result carries neither.
witness.observer: The owner receiving the erase result, and any later reader or persistence implementation of the Customer model.

open_points.subject: Customer created instant after erasure
open_points.text:
An erasure does not move it: it removes the revision and the
  last-changed instant with every other fact but the identity, and records
  the erased mark with its own instant (M04, A04 rule 1; owner, 2026-11-24).
open_points.question: Does an erased Customer lose its created instant, despite the unit saying that a Customer carries the instant it was created, or does that instant survive erasure?
options: The created instant survives on an erased Customer
The created instant is removed with the other facts
open_points.default_guess: Remove the created instant because the changed passage says every fact except identity is removed before the erased mark and its instant are recorded.

witness.initial: A Customer has a created instant, revision, last-changed instant, and contact data.
events: The owner erases the Customer's contact data.
The erased Customer is subsequently read or listed.
outcomes: The erased record still carries its created instant because every Customer carries one.
The erased record carries only its identity, erased mark, and erasure instant.
witness.observer: The owner or a trusted component reading the erased Customer representation.

open_points.subject: Customer erased mark and erasure instant
open_points.text:
records
  the erased mark with its own instant
open_points.question: What closed model facts represent the erased mark and its instant: does one timestamp both mark and date erasure, are a separate status or boolean and timestamp stored, or is erasure represented by a distinct tombstone model or variant?
options: One optional erasure timestamp is both the mark and its instant
A separate erased status or boolean plus an erasure timestamp
A distinct erased-Customer tombstone model or variant
open_points.default_guess: Use one optional UTC erasure timestamp whose presence is the erased mark.
